versions.B: B: price levels, heaps, order index

units.throughput: events per second of engine replay

limits.policy: A replay is stopped at the first block boundary after its limit and its remaining repeats and passes are skipped. A single sale that exceeds its limit is ended by terminating the child process. Stopped cells are saved with status 'stopped'.

metadata.timing_protocol: Fresh child process per cell. Untimed warm-up on the first 10,000 events (or a 2,000-order book), then five repeats, each on a fresh empty book after gc.collect(). The clock (time.perf_counter) encloses only loops over already parsed events, in blocks of at most 1,000 events; block times are summed. The cyclic garbage collector stays enabled. Generation, reading, parsing, digests, printing and dashboard work are outside the clock. Which version runs first is shuffled per cell with a recorded seed.
metadata.latency_protocol: Separate pass: time.perf_counter_ns around each ProcessEvent call. Percentiles use the nearest-rank convention: the smallest observation with at least p percent of the sample at or below it. Processing latency only; no queueing or network delay.
metadata.memory_protocol: Separate pass under tracemalloc. Preloaded input (streams up to 100,000 events) is allocated before tracing and excluded. Larger streams are parsed block by block inside the trace, so up to 1,000 parsed events are included. Included: the book and its indexes and the most recent returned result with its fills. No trade history is kept. Values are bytes of Python allocations, not auxiliary space and not process memory.
